{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= GUI Control - HTML

|descr= Returns [[true]] when HTML content was successfully loaded.

|s1= [[ctrlHTMLLoaded]] control

|p1= control: [[Control]]

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>
_control htmlLoad "test.html";
if (!ctrlHTMLLoaded _control) then {
	hint "Loading test.html failed!";
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[htmlLoad]] [[Arma: GUI Configuration]]
}}
